note: Recorded-style Committee answers for the mock providers (synthetic, digit-free, SEC-110). Two points per stage; the judge's reasons are the same shape with a rating.
bull: The recorded event is a favourable one for the company.
The rule evidence on the card passed its check.
bear: Past similar trades give a wide range of results.
A data flag limits how far the evidence can be trusted.
risk: Thin trading could make an exit costly.
The market regime may turn against the position.
judge: The favourable event outweighs the flagged data.
The range of past results is wide but acceptable.
